title: HotSweepPointAnalysis
description:
The analysis of one hot sweep point: exactly the output of
`hot_sweep_point.py`.

Every uncertainty is statistical. The scope's gain error, common to every
point on a scale, and the supply's readback offset and gain errors, common
to every point, aren't included.

current_amps.description: The mean current, with the quantisation floor.

voltage_volts.description: The voltage less the scale's offset, as a magnitude.

Derived.description:
A value derived by Python from measurements, with its standard uncertainty.

Unlike `Measurement` there are no samples: it's calculated from other
quantities, not sampled.
